title: Turning on the switch freezes the game

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
You really should name your switches so you know what function they are serving.
While there is nothing that can be determined with certainty from your screenshots, the fact that it is switch 001, and that you didn't properly give it a name, suggests to me that in all likelihood you have used that same switch (either intentionally or unintentionally) somewhere else, such as a parallel or autorun common event, or another event on the same map.
I would check all events on that map as well as all of your common events to see if switch001 has already been used.
In the future, I highly recommend you give your switches and variables names that will remind you of their function. For example you said this is for a maze, so perhaps "MazeCompletion" might be a good name for it.
Additionally, just a personal recommendation; I recommend not using Switch001. Technically, there is nothing wrong with using this switch. However, some plugins may use game switches and set their default switch to Switch001 (or Variable001).
You should always change default plugin parameters when that is the case, but just to err on the side of caution, I would reserve switch001 for plugins.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
I suggest you check the common events that you are NOT using.
switch 1 is automatically set as the condition if turning a common event to parallel or autorun.
if you had experimentally turned a common event to autorun while exploring your options and forgot to turn it back, that parallel would activate when that switch is used. and an empty parallel would still take quite some processing power away.
and please post a screenshot of your plugin manager so that we can see what plugins you have, even if it's only the default ones or if you think they have nothing to do with this problem.
